Do you have experience with mechanical or electrical engineering and an interest in designing cable support systems for naval vessels? 
 Function 
As a Marine Steelwork Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and modelling cable support systems, cable trays and penetrations for naval vessels. You will contribute to safe, reliable and efficient cable routing while ensuring compliance with naval engineering requirements. 
You will work closely with engineers and project teams from different disciplines to deliver practical and future-proof solutions. 
Your responsibilities include: - Designing and modelling cable trays, cable supports and penetrations. - Developing efficient and safe cable routing solutions. - Taking into account naval requirements such as EMC, shock and vibration loads, redundancy and safety. - Coordinating with other engineering disciplines throughout the project. - Preparing and maintaining technical documentation and project reports. 
 Requirements 
 - Bachelor's degree (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Maritime Engineering or a related technical discipline. - Experience with or interest in cable support systems and cable routing. - Knowledge of or willingness to learn naval engineering requirements such as EMC, shock, vibration and safety. - Experience with 3D CAD software is an advantage. - Structured, accurate and proactive working style. - Good communication skills and food command of English. 
 Company 
Electrical System Integrator for Marine and Industry 
 Offer 
 - A challenging role within an innovative maritime engineering environment. - Overtime compensation. - Training and professional development opportunities. - The opportunity to work on high-profile naval projects. Anita Radu

Nice Job for an Production Employee! Work as an Production Employee in metal production in Venray? You will work in a 2-shift system from Monday to Friday. You earn up to € 18,- gross per hour including allowances and you get many chances to show your skills and grow within the company. 
About the job 
As an Production Employee, you make sure the production process runs smoothly. You work with different machines and help produce metal parts according to quality standards. 
Your tasks include: - Setting up and operating machines; - Placing and removing metal parts; - Checking product quality; - Finishing products by deburring, grinding, and testing pressure; - Reporting machine issues or problems; - Keeping your workplace clean and safe. 
You work Monday to Friday in a 2-shift system: - Morning shift: 06:00 - 14:00; - Evening shift: 14:00 - 22:00. - On Friday you have different working hours; 6:00 to 12:30 and 12:30 to 19:00. 
Start after week 33! 
What we offer - A salary from € 16,77 to € 18,- gross per hour including allowances; - Travel allowance of € 0,21 per km; - 27 holidays and 8% holiday pay; - Pension from your first working day; - Work in a modern international production environment; - Opportunities to grow and develop your skills; - Chance of a permanent contract if you perform well. 
What we ask - You speak the English our German language; - Experience in production (and metal) is an advantage; - You are motivated and willing to learn and develop yourself. - Any experience with CNC is helpfull(not neccecary)
